name: web-scraping
description: Web scraping agent testing with mock websites featuring realistic HTML, pagination, authentication, rate limiting, and anti-bot measures

scenarioGenerators.name: e-commerce
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for scraping e-commerce product listings. Include pagination, filtering, price extraction, variant handling, and out-of-stock detection.

scenarioGenerators.name: content-site
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for scraping blog/news content. Include article extraction, author parsing, date parsing, comment scraping, and multi-page articles.

scenarioGenerators.name: directory
scenarioGenerators.prompt: Generate test scenarios for scraping business directories and listings. Include address parsing, phone extraction, hours of operation, and map coordinates.

constraints.name: rate-limiting
constraints.description: Mock sites enforce rate limits (requests per second); agents must respect them or handle 429 responses

constraints.name: robots-txt
constraints.description: Mock sites have robots.txt; agents should check and respect crawl directives

constraints.name: session-handling
constraints.description: Some sites require cookies/sessions; agents must maintain state across requests
